title: Fubar API Studio endpoint case
description: One cases/<name>.json inside an endpoint directory: a particular way of calling it. Everything here is an override - what a case leaves out, it inherits from the endpoint.

description.description: What this case is for. A case named "not-found" still owes the reader why.

pathParams.description: Values for the {param} placeholders in the endpoint's URL. {{variables}} are the environment's and are filled elsewhere.

body.description: Null inherits the endpoint's body. A body of type "none" is a decision to send nothing, which is not the same statement.

assertions.description: Stating any REPLACES the endpoint's: a not-found case expecting 404 cannot also carry the endpoint's "status equals 200".
